questionText: Why must farmers purchase hybrid seeds every year, and how can apomixis resolve this problem?

options.text: Hybrid seeds become sterile due to polyploidy; apomixis restores diploid meiotic vigor
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses concept details with distractor 'Hybrid seeds become sterile due to polyploidy; apomixis restores diploid meiotic vigor'.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses concept details with distractor 'Hybrid seeds rot rapidly in storage; apomixis thickens the seed coat'.

Hence Option C is correct.
